method: Curated extraction of observed catalogue names/topics; automatic matching against every baseline ACO role. This is not an exhaustive audit of each upstream codebase or a model-output benchmark.
stars_policy: Not used in ranking. Cached star counts in earlier discussion are not reproduced as live measurements.

sources.revision_scope: file snapshot where SHA is recorded; otherwise retrieved catalogue, not a repository-wide pinned audit
sources.license_observation: Mixed: many Apache-2.0 skills; document skills have separate source-available terms. Inspect each LICENSE.txt.
sources.coverage: directory inventory plus two inspected design/testing skill files
sources.use_for: Progressive disclosure, design intent and browser-based verification.
sources.do_not_assume: Do not apply the repository-level licence to every skill, or copy provider-specific brand rules. Directory inventory read through GitHub contents as well as README.
